name: @yomiscript/ja-accent
description: Japanese dictionary accent for YomiScript: OpenJTalk's front end (jpreprocess, NAIST-JDIC) as WebAssembly marks the accent phrases whose reading it shares

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm/pkg --out-name frontend wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/yomiscript_ja_accent.wasm
